observations.observation: A large downward flux and saved-baseline excursion is visible near the end of displayed sector S12. Verify detrending, product quality and sensitivity to that region before interpreting the short-period folded dip. This does not identify the mechanism or change a scientific disposition.

Positive shoulders on both sides of the central dip and additional out-of-transit structure are visible in the folded and odd/even displays, beyond the saved mean profile model. This reinforces the need to inspect variability, baseline and binary/blend alternatives already retained in the numerical review; no calibrated significance or classification is assigned.
